ios.desc:
Never miss what your favorite artists release.

Musicasm brings new albums, EPs, and singles from the artists you follow into one feed. Get release alerts, preview tracks in seconds, and play what catches your ear in Apple Music.

No account to create.

NEW RELEASES, ONE PLACE
See fresh albums, EPs, and singles every day without jumping between playlists, charts, and artist pages. Filter by your favorite genres to find more to listen to.

FOLLOW ARTISTS. KNOW WHAT'S NEW.
Import artists from your Apple Music library or add them yourself. Keep their latest releases together and get notified when something new comes out.

PREVIEW BEFORE YOU PLAY
Swipe through short, Story-style audio previews to decide what deserves a full listen.

MADE FOR APPLE MUSIC
Play albums, add releases to your library, and share your discoveries. Keep listening with Lock Screen controls and AirPlay.

Open Musicasm and hear what just dropped.

Musicasm Unlimited lets you follow as many artists as you like. Monthly and yearly subscriptions are available.

Terms of Use: https://ledak.ru/musicasm/terms-of-use.html
